sources.title: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a ...
sources.snippet: Z.ai has released GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series and the cheapest capable coding model the lab has shipped. It is a mixture-of-experts model with 320B total parameters and 18B active per token, a 1,048,576-token context window, and image and video input — released under an MIT license with weights on Hugging Face.
